assumptions: boron dose scales linearly with regional 10B concentration; other components are concentration-independent
declared PK curves are evaluated from beam-on; T/N ratios are assumed constant within each region over the irradiation
endpoint accumulates linearly with delivered source particles at constant source strength; anatomy and the endpoint map are static
region limits apply to the stated max/mean/D_x statistic only; no inter-fraction recovery or repopulation is modeled
PK curves are declared research inputs with a stated basis; they are not fitted, validated, or clinically qualified here
